_comment: Editable rule table (PRD section 6). The doctor owns these values; changing them needs no code change. Distances are in mm along the vessel; 'upstream' means towards the start of the measured path, which the doctor draws in the direction of blood flow.

calibration._comment: Order of preference is fixed by the PRD: DICOM geometry, then a marker of known size, then a device from our own micrometer-measured list. Never a device label size.

3._comment: juxta-anastomotic vein: compare with the vein beyond the narrowing

6._comment: shoulder bend (cephalic arch): use the vein just before the bend
